mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id as planId, data_date as dataDate, status, begin_time as beginTime, end_time as endTime, msg, execute_pool_id as executePoolId, execute_pool_name as executePoolName, execute_datasource_id as executeDatasourceId, execute_datasource_name as executeDatasourceName, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM t_quartz_task_status WHERE status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_quartz_task_status(plan_id, data_date, status, begin_time, end_time, msg, execute_pool_id, execute_pool_name, execute_datasource_id, execute_datasource_name, update_time, create_time, create_date) VALUES (#{entity.planId}, #{entity.dataDate}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.beginTime}, #{entity.endTime}, #{entity.msg}, #{entity.executePoolId}, #{entity.executePoolName}, #{entity.executeDatasourceId}, #{entity.executeDatasourceName}, #{entity.updateTime}, #{entity.createTime}, DATE_FORMAT(#{entity.createTime}, '%Y%m%d'))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_quartz_task_status SET status = #{entity.status}, begin_time = NULL, end_time = NULL, msg = #{entity.msg}, execute_pool_id = NULL, execute_pool_name = NULL, execute_datasource_id = NULL, execute_datasource_name = NULL, update_time = #{entity.updateTime} WHERE plan_id = #{entity.planId} AND data_date = #{entity.dataDate}
